name_zh: 恩特索罗/玻利维亚/革命/普选/锡/土地/政变/比克托/民族革命
description_zh: 比克托·恩特索罗 (1839-1896) 玻利维亚总统 (1880-1884) 军事独裁者，通过普选改革、锡矿开发、土地改革，推动玻利维亚民族革命，建立民选政府，实施锡矿资源控制，推动玻利维亚现代化，被誉为'锡矿总统'，推动玻利维亚民族觉醒。
description_en: Victor Pantantor (1839-1896) Bolivian President (1880-1884) military dictator, through universal suffrage reform, tin mine development, land reform, promoted Bolivian national revolution, established elected government, implemented tin mine resource control, promoted Bolivian modernization, known as 'Tin President', promoted Bolivian national awakening.
reason_zh: 恩特索罗代表玻利维亚如何通过普选改革实现民主转型，如何通过锡矿开发实现资源控制，以及土地改革如何推动玻利维亚民族革命，体现了玻利维亚的民族解放战略。
reason_en: Pantantor represents how Bolivia achieved democratic transition through universal suffrage reform, how tin mine development achieved resource control, and how land reform promoted Bolivian national revolution, embodies Bolivia's national liberation strategy.

steps_en: Study Pantantor early military career/Bolivian political environment/national consciousness
Analyze 1879-1884 presidency/universal suffrage reform/tin mine development
